visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair wearing a white button-down shirt speaks directly into the camera in a selfie perspective. The background is a brightly lit, modern hotel lobby or restaurant area with soft, warm ceiling lights. (2) Graphic overlays of the Tokyo Big Sight building and the Washington Hotel appear over footage of the man walking into a breakfast buffet area. He gestures towards a digital signage screen displaying a picture of curry bread. (3) A close-up shot shows a large metal spoon scooping a generous portion of bright orange salmon roe from a white container. The roe is then poured over a steaming bowl of white rice. (4) The camera focuses on a Suzumo brand automatic rice dispensing machine. A finger presses the '150g' button on a blue touch screen, and a perfectly shaped mound of white rice falls into a grey bowl below. (5) An ice cream scooper is used to take a large scoop of pink minced tuna from a white tray. The tray is surrounded by other condiments and garnishes on a buffet table. (6) The man is shown eating the salmon roe and rice bowl with black chopsticks. As he takes a bite and closes his eyes in satisfaction, colorful psychedelic space graphics and a classic 'He-Man' meme animation appear behind him to symbolize his enjoyment. (7) Panning shots showcase the hotel's drink station featuring several modern dispensing machines by Suntory and UCC. A cold food section with plates of smoked salmon and salad greens is also visible.
